claim_boundary: This specification makes the future BACH adapter implementable without copying generic merge mechanics. The inspected BACH source can lazily select its existing external TransitSync seam, but this document is not an implemented Ocean adapter, old/new equivalence, BACH-IN, migration, rollback, bundle, installer, or off-host evidence.

application: live BACH database schema and application rows
carrier: verified transit snapshot and manifest pairs
adapter: BACH tuple and text output translation
forbidden: adapter reimplementation of SQLite backup or merge
carrier access to BACH tables beyond configured merge and redaction policies
parallel legacy and carrier writes after BACH-IN

fields.deferred_snapshots: map from verified snapshot basename to failed_at, retry_after and error class
fields.last_daily_push: local calendar date plus published snapshot basename
fields.migration: legacy sync-state import marker and source hash

activation.disable: remove only the injected marker if present

daily_push.rule: publish at most once per configured local calendar day
daily_push.evidence: carrier snapshot identity recorded in adapter state
daily_push.failure: do not advance last_daily_push unless carrier push succeeds

heartbeat.compatibility_file: injected heartbeat.json path outside the carrier
heartbeat.malformed_input: fail closed for explicit sync; status may report unavailable without rewriting

pull_selection.rule: from carrier pending snapshots, exclude active cooldown entries and choose the greatest created_at; tie-break by node_id and basename
pull_selection.no_pending: update own heartbeat and return the legacy no-newer-backups tuple
pull_selection.success: clear the selected cooldown entry and update heartbeat only after carrier state advances

cooldown.pruning: remove expired or malformed entries before selection

cleanup.interactive_bach_command_authority: dry_run false authorizes carrier apply and all-node scope
cleanup.dry_run: carrier dry-run; no pair is removed

operations.name: init
operations.rule: Do not copy an application database. Require an application-created schema, then validate carrier configuration.

operations.name: status
operations.output: legacy-compatible text assembled from carrier status, verified snapshot metadata and heartbeat compatibility state

operations.name: sync
operations.rule: check heartbeat conflicts, select at most one pending snapshot, merge it, then publish one snapshot; never publish after a failed merge

known_source_defects.effect: Current init copies a documented stale application database source.
known_source_defects.target: No automatic first-copy; application creates and migrates its schema.

known_source_defects.effect: Current handler accepts dry_run but ignores it for every operation.
known_source_defects.target: The adapter honors dry_run for every state-changing operation; this correction needs explicit equivalence classification after the hold.

preconditions: legacy transit inventory and sync_state hash recorded
steps: map legacy host names to carrier node ids without changing snapshot payloads
translate last_pulled and active deferred entries into carrier and adapter state
leave legacy .bachdb files untouched until equivalence and rollback tests pass
enable one adapter write path and guard the legacy write path
migration.rollback: disable the adapter, restore the recorded legacy state copy, and keep carrier artifacts additive until reviewed

acceptance: all nine operations exercised against the same anonymized old/new starting state after the hold
allowed files, rows, messages and failure classes compared
migration and rollback executed on copies
legacy parallel writes proven disabled during BACH-IN
